products.name: Hour One
products.note: AI avatar video; virtual presenters; enterprise video; likeness consent; Israeli vendor

reading.body:
Hour One is an Israeli vendor offering AI-generated avatar video, with products focused on virtual presenters, enterprise video, and likeness consent for human subjects.

The product sits in the video generation and editing category, where the core computational task is synthesizing realistic human appearance and speech from learned representations. That workload is GPU-intensive at inference, meaning even a deployment-stage product like this draws on data center capacity, not just the training runs that precede it.

The available data covers product category and vendor origin only. It does not include revenue, customer scale, model architecture, compute footprint, or infrastructure arrangements. Nothing here supports conclusions about Hour One's position in the market relative to other avatar video providers.
